## How it was checked

- [ ] `dotnet build DwgIO.slnx -c Release` has no warnings
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] JSON exports and `dwgio inspect` output of the same drawings before and after are identical, or the differences are listed and intended
- [ ] The change is original work; no code or text is copied from other projects
- [ ] No drawings, customer data, vendor code or binaries are added
